summary: Stop body-routed primary role and status scanning when a different exact RFI or Submittal section begins.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy
FR-PARSE-007 preserves exact workflow evidence boundaries
Offline reproduction showed later cross-type sections changing a body-routed primary RFI role and Submittal status
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only exact normalized workflow headings create boundaries; ambiguous prose does not.
The first exact heading remains the primary routing context and later headings remain references, not inferred relationships.
A valid Email Subject retains its established priority over cross-type body references; a different same-type identifier still closes its scope.
The change does not infer authority, approval precedence or semantic thread membership.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer document, mailbox or provider API is used.
